title: Per-contract burst slab scheduling log — Dec 2026
sheet_summary: Working scheduling ledger to track per-contract reserved slabs and short-term burst assignments across regions. This sheet captures active windows where customers can spill into a shared burst pool, priority order, and the operational actions required to reallocate slabs when utilization or infra events occur. Not final — used by capacity ops and on-call SRE during allocation windows.

runbook_notes:
- When shared-burst is >80% consumed in a region: notify capacity-ops and reduce non-critical burst assignments by 30%.
- Emergency reassignments: if reserved_vgpus are preempted, attempt region-failover chain (same-cloud fallback -> nearest-region -> degrade to quantized model) and escalate to on-call SRE.
- Billing tie-out: record actual vGPU-hours per contract at end of allocation window and send preliminary reconciliation to finance-runbook.
- Pre-deployment check: confirm node label 'burst-enabled' and that autoscaler has correct min/max for dedicated pools.
- For customers with KMS constraints, do not place burst workloads on shared nodes unless explicit crosswalk ticket is approved.

capacity_assumptions:
- Node mix: p4d-equivalent (64 vGPU slots) in us-west1/us-east1; A100-equivalent (40 vGPU slots) in eu-west1 and ap-southeast1.
- Average slot efficiency: 0.78 (accounts for packing waste and maintenance).
- Planned maintenance windows: nightly region rolling updates 02:00-05:00 local time (expected 3% capacity loss).
- Forecasted customer ramp for Q1 2027: +12% committed vGPU demand across Gold/Platinum tiers.
risk_assessment:
- High risk: cross-region failover may violate data residency for HealthMesh (eu-west1) — require legal signoff before any automated failover.
- Medium risk: shared burst exhaustion during third-party event (e.g., major model release) could cause latency degradation for Gold customers. Mitigation: pre-warm canary pools.
- Low risk: slight billing variance (+/-3%) from predicted token-to-vGPU conversion; finance notified.
